name: Construct
what_it_is: Construct 3 is a browser-based 2D game engine that needs no programming, sold by subscription.
platforms: Browser-based editor; the vendor page says games can be made for mobiles, desktops, consoles and web.
pricing: Personal, Startup, Business and Educational plans; free edition limited to 50 events, 2 layers and 2 effects. Personal price not captured in page text.
key_features: Unlimited events, layers and effects on paid plans
Free Construct Game Services plan on non-education paid plans
notable: Zero royalties on anything created, per the buy page

facts.fact: The Construct buy page describes Construct 3 as a video game maker for building games for mobiles, desktops, consoles and web.
The free edition is limited to 50 events, 2 layers and 2 effects; paid versions are unlimited.
The page lists Personal, Startup, Business and Educational plans, with zero royalties on anything created.

The Startup Plan is for registered businesses with up to $50,000 USD annual revenue, up to $100,000 USD assets and no more than 3 employees; the Business Plan is required for other registered businesses.
The Personal License is not permitted for purchase by registered businesses.
